# Maxora Technology

> Maxora Technology is a software development company serving businesses globally, with regional presence in Punjab, India. The company builds custom digital products and business systems for organizations that need to launch, modernize, scale, or automate their operations.

## Company

- Website: https://maxoratechnology.com
- Email: info@maxoratechnology.com
- Phone: +91 78149 50023
- Service reach: Global; regional presence in Punjab, India
- Audience: Businesses seeking enterprise-grade digital solutions, software scaling, and workflow automation

## Services

- [Services overview](https://maxoratechnology.com/Services): Overview of Maxora Technology's software and digital services.
- [Custom web development](https://maxoratechnology.com/service/web-development): Web applications built with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with attention to performance, SEO, and scalability.
- [Mobile app development](https://maxoratechnology.com/service/App-development): iOS and Android applications, including cross-platform development with React Native and Flutter.
- [Custom CRM and ERP development](https://maxoratechnology.com/service/Crm-erp): Business management systems, workflow automation, integrations, and reporting.
- [eCommerce development](https://maxoratechnology.com/service/Ecommerce): Custom and platform-based online stores, commerce integrations, and scalable shopping experiences.
- [WordPress development](https://maxoratechnology.com/service/Wordpress): Custom WordPress websites, themes, plugins, and WooCommerce solutions.
